Container.Name: domain-watchdog
Container.Overview: Domain Watchdog monitors domain lifecycle via RDAP, sends alerts when domains change status, and can automatically attempt registration when a domain drops. Requires an existing PostgreSQL and Redis container on the same Docker network. Deploy domain-watchdog-worker alongside this container.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL container | Redis container | Both must be on the same Docker network as this container | Also deploy domain-watchdog-worker

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Domain Watchdog web interface.

Config.Name: Caddy Data
Config.Description: Caddy TLS certificate and state storage.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Random secret key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to true if behind a reverse proxy with SSL. Set to false for plain HTTP access.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Internal Caddy server binding. Leave as :80 unless you know what you are doing.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Container Name
Config.Description: Container name of your existing PostgreSQL instance. Must be on the same Docker network.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Port
Config.Description: Port your PostgreSQL container listens on.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Database name for Domain Watchdog. Create it first: docker exec -it postgresql psql -U app -c "CREATE DATABASE domainwatchdog;"

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password for the above user.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Version
Config.Description: PostgreSQL server version. Match your existing container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Charset
Config.Description: Database character set. Leave as utf8.

Config.Name: Redis Container Name
Config.Description: Container name of your existing Redis instance. Must be on the same Docker network.

Config.Name: Redis Port
Config.Description: Port your Redis container listens on.

Config.Name: Mailer DSN
Config.Description: SMTP connection string for email alerts. Example: smtp://user:pass@smtp.example.com:587 — Leave as null://null to disable email.

Config.Name: Mailer From Address
Config.Description: Sender email address for outgoing notifications.
